enrichment method: we utilized TX-114 phase partitioning to fractionate Mp proteins into three fractions
fractionation method: separated using reversed phase gradient on a Dionex Ultimate 3000 RSLC UPLC instrument
instrument: coupled directly to a Q Exactive HF mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific)
ionization type: coupled directly to a Q Exactive HF mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific) via electrospray ionization
labeling: for peptide and protein quantification using the LFQ algorithm
